facts.text: Reverse-engineered a vendor SQL Server database (Agvance) with 925 tables, 14,539 columns, and zero foreign keys. Recovered 697 natural keys, audited 128 Agvance API operations, and produced a 10-report evidence base, inferring relationships across about 85% of tables.

Found a settlement field that double-counted bushels by 1.395x, a business rule hiding 967,647 bu of open corn, and zero prices in 114,040 of 178,570 settlement rows. Fixed the zero prices with a settlement-line price fallback.

Designed a star-schema analytics database (fact, dimension, and DECIMAL snapshot tables) with T-SQL ETL on SQL Server Agent: nightly rebuilds, 15-minute conditional refreshes, and reconciliation against fresh recomputation. Unchanged growers take about 8 ms of refresh work versus 360 ms for a full recomputation.
Cut the heaviest grower's recomputation from 14.3 s to 0.27 s (52x) with read-only indexes and concurrent-request deduplication.
Load-tested 7 routes across 10 growers and 10 rounds with zero connection-pool timeouts; p50 about 2.1 s and p95 3.2 to 4.2 s at 10 concurrent requests.

Built an async Python/FastAPI backend with 14 routes across 8 grower insight tiers, integrating Agvance SQL Server, Agvance REST, Barchart, and farmdoc. Pydantic, SQLAlchemy, ContextVar request isolation, standardized error handling, and 196 offline pytest checks run via pre-commit.
Compared k-means, GMM, hierarchical clustering, DBSCAN, and HDBSCAN for grower peer segmentation, then built a selling-behavior model combining GMM, HMM, and particle filtering, tracked in MLflow.

Built and benchmarked a local multi-agent system on DGX Spark (Gemma 4 orchestrator, specialized sub-agents, llama.cpp, OpenAI Agents SDK) answering questions against live APIs: 7 of 7 correct with zero unsupported numerical outputs, and 45% faster inference via speculative decoding (DFlash and MTP).
Generated grower-specific summaries with Claude Sonnet 5.5 on AWS Bedrock, with prompt-hash caching.

roles.title: AI Solutions Developer

headline: uiuc-ai.cost

facts.text: Built an LLM grading system for finance coursework: Canvas REST API ingestion, DOCX, PDF, and text extraction, JSON rubrics and solution keys, and Claude on Azure AI Foundry with structured tool calls. Every submission is graded twice; divergence above 5% or a grade-boundary result goes to human review.
Grades post hidden and need a separate, human-approved release step.

317 correctness checks and 46 fault-injection checks, covering 240 concurrent operations, 23 hostile queue messages, and injected HTTP 429 errors. Includes prompt-injection detection, score clamping, and missing-criteria and solution-key leakage checks.

Traced tokens, cache usage, latency, and retries across 860 submissions in two full-module runs: $0.04 per submission ($35 total), with prompt caching serving about 75% of token volume. TPM-based capacity planning on Azure AI Foundry.

Deployed on Azure with Bicep, Container Apps Jobs, App Service, and a FastAPI review console, with Blob Storage as the system of record and queue-based processing. Managed identity throughout (no shared keys or SAS links) and GitHub Actions OIDC deployments.

facts.text: Built agentic RAG with LangGraph and Qwen-3-32B, reaching 95% retrieval accuracy, with reusable Claude Code/Codex skills integrated through FastAPI.

Built a 10K+ row workflow-routing benchmark with rule-based labels, ambiguity modeling, group-based validation, and Greedy/Viterbi/SMC decoding. Sentence-embedding Logistic Regression reached 0.641 macro F1 and 0.906 top-3 accuracy on unseen seed groups.

Extracted 70+ variables from 15,856 SEC enforcement documents (2010-2025), using DeepSeek-V4 Flash for indicator coding and Regex for violation detection across Administrative Proceedings and Litigation Releases.
Moved 7,000+ documents from MongoDB into PostgreSQL vector stores in under 10 seconds with 100% data integrity, using multiprocessing and Pydantic schema validation.
Built async ETL on Azure Container Instances over paginated Ticketmaster API data: 1,000+ event records per 1.5s, with a 60%+ latency improvement.
Built knowledge-base ingestion from GitHub and Asana, reducing processing latency by 90%.
Built Tableau dashboards and reporting covering 8,700+ operational and compliance events.
Soybean disease detection on 10,000+ images in TensorFlow: GLCM, FFT, and Sobel features, ConvNeXt and ResNet models, and Grad-CAM interpretation.
